observation_kind: targeted current official API-authentication, entity-filter, OGC-conformance and grid-supply checks; not independent bulk HTTP fetches
rules: The Use land and property data API is documented as a RESTful API using JSON.
Creating an account provides an API key for endpoint access.
Authentication is required on every API request.
The API key is supplied in the Authorization request header.
The documentation advises an Accept header of application/json.
Endpoint parameters are passed as URL-encoded parameters.
All documented endpoints use the /api/v1 base.
The /datasets response lists dataset names and titles.
The /datasets/{dataset_name} endpoint returns dataset metadata and resources.
Dataset metadata can include state, update frequency, version, file size, format and last-updated values.
A current-file endpoint returns a signed download URL valid for 10 seconds.
Current-file download links require the relevant licence and dataset access.
The /datasets/history/{dataset_name} endpoint lists available historical resources.
A historical-file endpoint also returns a download URL valid for 10 seconds.
A 403 can represent a missing key, unsigned licence or missing paid-dataset access.
A 404 can represent an unknown URL, invalid API key or nonexistent resource or file.

The q parameter searches by postcode or Unique Property Reference Number.
The entity endpoint accepts one or more typology values.
The organisation_entity parameter filters entities managed by specified organisations.
The entity parameter filters by one or more entity numbers.
The curie parameter filters entities by one or more CURIE identifiers.
The prefix parameter filters entities by one or more prefixes.
The period parameter controls whether current or all entries are returned.
geometry_reference applies spatial relations using geometries of entities with supplied references.
geometry_curie applies spatial relations using geometries of entities matching supplied CURIEs.
The quality parameter filters entities by one or more quality values.
Longitude requires latitude, and latitude requires longitude, for point-intersection searches.
The geometry parameter accepts one or more WKT geometries for spatial filtering.
